name: Telluric-Hollow
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs a nearby asteroid belt, stark under a black sky.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Regular pulses leave the buried megastructure aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
